name: Degree-4 polynomials with only the 3-point Gauss-Lobatto values (2N - 3 < k)
source: Zhang and Shu, J. Comput. Phys. 229 (2010), (2.1)-(2.6), Theorem 2.2; the Lax-Friedrichs flux h(u, v) = (f(u) + f(v) - a (v - u))/2 for f(u) = u, a = max|f'| = 1

reconstruction.update: ubar - lam*((u0r + up1l)/2 - (up1l - u0r)/2 - ((um1r + u0l)/2 - (u0l - um1r)/2))

claims.why: Simpson is not exact for y^4, so ubar is not a combination of the point values and stays a hypothesis of its own; the update ubar - lam u0r + lam um1r has the weight -lam on u0r, negative for lam > 0 (a quartic p_0 with u0r = m and the other values and ubar at M exists)
